build_mujoco_mesh_from_blender: build a MujocoMesh from a Blender mesh with a specific material index and two-sided flag
save_mesh_to_msh_format: save a MujocoMesh instance to a binary .msh file at the given filepath
create_mesh_asset_xml_elements: create XML mesh asset elements and export .msh files for a Blender mesh and its materials
create_material_asset_xml_element: create an XML material element with specular, shininess, reflectance, and rgba attributes from a Blender material
export_blender_objects_to_mujoco_assets: export a sequence of Blender scene objects to a Mujoco asset XML element with optional modifier application
